Package org.apache.hadoop.hdfs.server.federation.store.impl

@Private @Evolving package org.apache.hadoop.hdfs.server.federation.store.impl
Contains implementations of the state store API interfaces. All classes derive from RecordStore. The API definitions are contained in the org.apache.hadoop.hdfs.server.federation.store package.

    org.apache.hadoop.hdfs.server.federation.store
    The federation state store tracks persistent values that are shared between multiple routers.

    Contains the abstract definitions of the API request and response objects for the various state store APIs.
